support.screened_definition: every clean-cell rectangle inside the fixed unique-molecule budget; a rectangle is used by the screen only if its four molecules are pairwise distinct, so same_edit can never be satisfied by an identical molecule appearing twice
support.screened_set_note: The screen covers every clean-cell rectangle reachable inside the fixed unique-molecule budget; no favourable subset was searched for.

decomposition.statement: dU and dg are identical across the two contexts, so the entire model double difference D_LCRC is produced by the nonlinear readout applied to two different initial states (U(A), g(A)); it is not an input-increment difference.

strict_rectangles_note: all 38 rectangles that pass the exact-action screen; ids are official Valid row ids plus the read-only Valid-cache row used for the records

examples.label: strict: identical edit record and identical dg
strict: largest LCRC double difference inside the strict subset
non-empty identical edit: LCRC tracked the real change
largest real double differences: LCRC accurate
largest real double differences: LCRC misses

limits.no_approximate_matching: records are exact canonical-byte digests; no learned-embedding similarity, no MCS alignment, no new graph search was used.
limits.no_synthetic_states: every state belongs to a real official-Valid molecule; no mixed or interpolated state was constructed.
limits.clean_cells_only: multi-molecule aggregated cells are excluded from the record analysis so a cell is never mistaken for one molecule.
limits.not_a_causal_claim: exact state accounting is not a unique chemical causal attribution.
